widgets.title: Admin error rate

widgets.description: Last seven days versus the preceding seven days of observed API SERVER spans, excluding /_status. Requests and response-time changes are relative percentages; Apdex is a score difference; error rate is a percentage-point difference. Positive means increased, not necessarily improved. Requires at least 14 days of retained traces and comparable sampling. Missing periods and zero percentage-change baselines show N/A; partial retention cannot be detected automatically.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH resource_filter AS (
  SELECT fingerprint
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_traces_v3_resource
  WHERE simpleJSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'notification-api'
    AND seen_at_ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 604800 - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    countIf(timestamp >= $start_datetime) AS current_count,
    countIf(timestamp < $start_datetime) AS previous_count,
    sumIf(toFloat64(duration_nano), timestamp >= $start_datetime) AS current_duration,
    sumIf(toFloat64(duration_nano), timestamp < $start_datetime) AS previous_duration,
    countIf(timestamp >= $start_datetime AND (has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%')) AS current_errors,
    countIf(timestamp < $start_datetime AND (has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%')) AS previous_errors,
    sumIf(if(has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%', 0.0, if(duration_nano <= 1000000000, 1.0, if(duration_nano <= 4000000000, 0.5, 0.0))), timestamp >= $start_datetime) AS current_satisfaction,
    sumIf(if(has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%', 0.0, if(duration_nano <= 1000000000, 1.0, if(duration_nano <= 4000000000, 0.5, 0.0))), timestamp < $start_datetime) AS previous_satisfaction
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN resource_filter
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 604800 - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
    AND timestamp >= $start_datetime - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND timestamp < $end_datetime
    AND kind = 2 AND attributes_string['http.route'] != '/_status'
), metrics AS (
  SELECT arrayJoin([
    tuple('Requests', nullIf(toFloat64(current_count), 0), nullIf(toFloat64(previous_count), 0), '', '%', toUInt8(0)),
    tuple('Apdex', current_satisfaction / nullIf(current_count, 0), previous_satisfaction / nullIf(previous_count, 0), '', ' score', toUInt8(3)),
    tuple('Avg response', current_duration / nullIf(current_count, 0) / 1000000, previous_duration / nullIf(previous_count, 0) / 1000000, ' ms', '%', toUInt8(2)),
    tuple('Error rate', 100.0 * current_errors / nullIf(current_count, 0), 100.0 * previous_errors / nullIf(previous_count, 0), '%', ' pp', toUInt8(2))
  ]) AS metric FROM stats
)
SELECT
  metric.1 AS Metric,
  ifNull(concat(toString(round(metric.2, metric.6)), metric.4), 'N/A') AS `This week`,
  ifNull(concat(toString(round(metric.3, metric.6)), metric.4), 'N/A') AS `Previous week`,
  concat(
    multiIf(
      isNull(delta) OR round(delta, if(metric.1 = 'Apdex', 3, 2)) = 0 OR metric.1 = 'Requests', '⚪ ',
      (metric.1 = 'Apdex' AND delta > 0) OR (metric.1 IN ('Avg response', 'Error rate') AND delta < 0), '🟢 ',
      '🔴 '
    ),
    ifNull(concat(if(round(delta, if(metric.1 = 'Apdex', 3, 2)) > 0, '+', ''), toString(round(delta, if(metric.1 = 'Apdex', 3, 2))), metric.5), 'N/A')
  ) AS Change
FROM (
  SELECT metric,
    if(metric.5 = '%', 100.0 * (metric.2 - metric.3) / nullIf(metric.3, 0), metric.2 - metric.3) AS delta
  FROM metrics
)

widgets.title: Admin - week-over-week

widgets.description: Rolling seven-day daily report for notification-api. Day 1 through Day 8 are Toronto dates (see Period row); edge dates are partial. Summary aggregates all requests, not daily averages. CPU and memory are observed one-minute totals across matching service pods, averaged over available minutes; missing collection can understate totals. DB call avg includes all observed database CLIENT spans, including health-check work, not a database-time percentage. Request rows exclude /_status. Missing observations show N/A. No environment selector; data is scoped to this SigNoz instance.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH
  toTimeZone($start_datetime, 'America/Toronto') AS window_start,
  toTimeZone($end_datetime, 'America/Toronto') AS window_end,
  toStartOfDay(window_end) AS today,
resource_filter AS (
  SELECT fingerprint FROM signoz_traces.distributed_traces_v3_resource
  WHERE simpleJSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'notification-api'
    AND seen_at_ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
),
periods AS (
  SELECT
    toUInt8(number) AS period,
    if(number = 8, window_start, greatest(window_start, today - toIntervalDay(7 - toInt32(number)))) AS period_start,
    if(number = 8, window_end, least(window_end, today - toIntervalDay(6 - toInt32(number)))) AS period_end
  FROM numbers(9)
),
requests AS (
  SELECT
    arrayJoin([toUInt8(7 - dateDiff('day', toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Toronto'), today)), toUInt8(8)]) AS period,
    count() AS request_count,
    sum(toFloat64(duration_nano)) AS duration_sum,
    countIf(has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%') AS errors,
    sum(if(has_error OR response_status_code LIKE '5%', 0.0,
      if(duration_nano <= 1000000000, 1.0, if(duration_nano <= 4000000000, 0.5, 0.0)))) AS satisfaction
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN resource_filter
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
    AND timestamp >= $start_datetime AND timestamp < $end_datetime
    AND kind = 2 AND attributes_string['http.route'] != '/_status'
  GROUP BY period
),
database_calls AS (
  SELECT
    arrayJoin([toUInt8(7 - dateDiff('day', toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Toronto'), today)), toUInt8(8)]) AS period,
    count() AS db_count,
    sum(toFloat64(duration_nano)) AS db_duration_sum
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE resource_fingerprint GLOBAL IN resource_filter
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
    AND timestamp >= $start_datetime AND timestamp < $end_datetime
    AND kind = 3
    AND (attributes_string['db.system'] != '' OR attributes_string['db.system.name'] != ''
      OR attributes_string['db.statement'] != '' OR attributes_string['db.query.text'] != '')
  GROUP BY period
),
metric_series AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT metric_name, fingerprint
  FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4_1day
  WHERE metric_name IN ('k8s.pod.cpu.usage', 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set')
    AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'k8s.namespace.name') = 'notification-canada-ca'
    AND match(JSONExtractString(labels, 'k8s.pod.name'), '^notify-api-')
),
pod_minutes AS (
  SELECT metric_name, fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 60000) * 60000 AS minute_ms,
    avg(value) AS pod_value
  FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
  WHERE metric_name IN ('k8s.pod.cpu.usage', 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set')
    AND (metric_name, fingerprint) GLOBAL IN metric_series
    AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms AND unix_milli < $end_timestamp_ms
  GROUP BY metric_name, fingerprint, minute_ms
),
service_minutes AS (
  SELECT metric_name, minute_ms, sum(pod_value) AS service_value
  FROM pod_minutes GROUP BY metric_name, minute_ms
),
resources AS (
  SELECT
    arrayJoin([toUInt8(7 - dateDiff('day', toTimeZone(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(minute_ms), 'America/Toronto'), today)), toUInt8(8)]) AS period,
    countIf(metric_name = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage') AS cpu_samples,
    avgIf(service_value, metric_name = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage') AS cpu_cores,
    countIf(metric_name = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set') AS memory_samples,
    avgIf(service_value, metric_name = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set') AS memory_bytes
  FROM service_minutes GROUP BY period
),
cells AS (
  SELECT periods.period AS period, entry.1 AS row_order, entry.2 AS metric, entry.3 AS cell
  FROM periods
  LEFT JOIN requests USING period
  LEFT JOIN database_calls USING period
  LEFT JOIN resources USING period
  ARRAY JOIN [
    tuple(0, 'Period (Toronto)', if(period_end <= period_start, 'N/A',
      if(periods.period = 8, 'Last 7 days', concat(
        formatDateTime(period_start, '%a %m-%d', 'America/Toronto'),
        if(periods.period IN (0, 7), ' (partial)', ''))))),
    tuple(1, 'Apdex', if(request_count > 0, toString(round(satisfaction / nullIf(request_count, 0), 3)), 'N/A')),
    tuple(2, 'Resp. time', if(request_count > 0, concat(toString(round(duration_sum / nullIf(request_count, 0) / 1000000, 2)), ' ms'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(3, 'Throughput', if(request_count > 0 AND period_end > period_start,
      concat(toString(round(60.0 * request_count / nullIf(toUnixTimestamp(period_end) - toUnixTimestamp(period_start), 0), 2)), ' rpm'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(4, 'Error rate', if(request_count > 0, concat(toString(round(100.0 * errors / nullIf(request_count, 0), 2)), '%'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(5, 'CPU (total pods)', if(cpu_samples > 0, concat(toString(round(cpu_cores, 3)), ' cores'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(6, 'Memory (total pods)', if(memory_samples > 0, concat(toString(round(memory_bytes / 1000000, 2)), ' MB'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(7, 'DB call avg', if(db_count > 0, concat(toString(round(db_duration_sum / nullIf(db_count, 0) / 1000000, 2)), ' ms'), 'N/A'))
  ] AS entry
)
SELECT metric AS Metric,
  maxIf(cell, period = 0) AS `Day 1`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 1) AS `Day 2`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 2) AS `Day 3`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 3) AS `Day 4`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 4) AS `Day 5`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 5) AS `Day 6`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 6) AS `Day 7`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 7) AS `Day 8`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 8) AS `Summary`
FROM cells GROUP BY row_order, metric ORDER BY row_order

  GROUP BY period
),
metric_series AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT metric_name, fingerprint
  FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4_1day
  WHERE metric_name IN ('k8s.pod.cpu.usage', 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set')
    AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'k8s.namespace.name') = 'notification-canada-ca'
    AND match(JSONExtractString(labels, 'k8s.pod.name'), '^notify-admin-')
),
pod_minutes AS (
  SELECT metric_name, fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 60000) * 60000 AS minute_ms,
    avg(value) AS pod_value
  FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
  WHERE metric_name IN ('k8s.pod.cpu.usage', 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set')
    AND (metric_name, fingerprint) GLOBAL IN metric_series
    AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms AND unix_milli < $end_timestamp_ms
  GROUP BY metric_name, fingerprint, minute_ms
),
service_minutes AS (
  SELECT metric_name, minute_ms, sum(pod_value) AS service_value
  FROM pod_minutes GROUP BY metric_name, minute_ms
),
resources AS (
  SELECT
    arrayJoin([toUInt8(7 - dateDiff('day', toTimeZone(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(minute_ms), 'America/Toronto'), today)), toUInt8(8)]) AS period,
    countIf(metric_name = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage') AS cpu_samples,
    avgIf(service_value, metric_name = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage') AS cpu_cores,
    countIf(metric_name = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set') AS memory_samples,
    avgIf(service_value, metric_name = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set') AS memory_bytes
  FROM service_minutes GROUP BY period
),
cells AS (
  SELECT periods.period AS period, entry.1 AS row_order, entry.2 AS metric, entry.3 AS cell
  FROM periods
  LEFT JOIN requests USING period
  LEFT JOIN database_calls USING period
  LEFT JOIN resources USING period
  ARRAY JOIN [
    tuple(0, 'Period (Toronto)', if(period_end <= period_start, 'N/A',
      if(periods.period = 8, 'Last 7 days', concat(
        formatDateTime(period_start, '%a %m-%d', 'America/Toronto'),
        if(periods.period IN (0, 7), ' (partial)', ''))))),
    tuple(1, 'Apdex', if(request_count > 0, toString(round(satisfaction / nullIf(request_count, 0), 3)), 'N/A')),
    tuple(2, 'Resp. time', if(request_count > 0, concat(toString(round(duration_sum / nullIf(request_count, 0) / 1000000, 2)), ' ms'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(3, 'Throughput', if(request_count > 0 AND period_end > period_start,
      concat(toString(round(60.0 * request_count / nullIf(toUnixTimestamp(period_end) - toUnixTimestamp(period_start), 0), 2)), ' rpm'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(4, 'Error rate', if(request_count > 0, concat(toString(round(100.0 * errors / nullIf(request_count, 0), 2)), '%'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(5, 'CPU (total pods)', if(cpu_samples > 0, concat(toString(round(cpu_cores, 3)), ' cores'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(6, 'Memory (total pods)', if(memory_samples > 0, concat(toString(round(memory_bytes / 1000000, 2)), ' MB'), 'N/A')),
    tuple(7, 'DB call avg', if(db_count > 0, concat(toString(round(db_duration_sum / nullIf(db_count, 0) / 1000000, 2)), ' ms'), 'N/A'))
  ] AS entry
)
SELECT metric AS Metric,
  maxIf(cell, period = 0) AS `Day 1`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 1) AS `Day 2`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 2) AS `Day 3`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 3) AS `Day 4`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 4) AS `Day 5`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 5) AS `Day 6`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 6) AS `Day 7`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 7) AS `Day 8`,
  maxIf(cell, period = 8) AS `Summary`
FROM cells GROUP BY row_order, metric ORDER BY row_order
